olong.title: O Long Tea Plus Sampling at 4 Sacred Festivals

clear.title: 'Confident in Standard Helmets – Home Safe' Campaign
clear.challenge: Engaging motorbike taxi drivers at high-density terminals and staging a massive nationwide media rally.
clear.solution: Phase 1: Helmet recall and replacement at 4 key terminals; Phase 2: Press conference & grand parade with Ambassador Thanh Hang.
clear.result: Replaced 1,000 standard helmets (250 per terminal); 5,000 participants (Youth Union, Nat'l Traffic Safety Committee).

lays.title: Lay's Stax North-South Christmas Tour
lays.scale: Dinh Tien Hoang Walking Street (HN) & AEON MALL Tan Phu (HCMC)
lays.challenge: Creating high-impact consumer buzz during Christmas holidays (Dec 23-25) simultaneously in both Hanoi and HCMC.
lays.solution: Fabricated the 15-second Lay's Stax Express Train, interactive mini-games, and themed photo-opportunity booths.
lays.result: Tens of thousands of youth engaged in the 15s check-in tour and product sampling.

panasonic.title: Panasonic DMX Dealer Convention
panasonic.challenge: Executing a dual-phase program: daytime tech Product Tour and evening VIP Dealer Appreciation Gala in a single day.
panasonic.solution: Orchestrated Product Tour (14:00-17:30) at Ballroom Charlotte/Foyer Crystal and Gala Dinner (18:15-21:30) at Ballroom Crystal.
panasonic.result: Flawless luxury execution, perfect timing schedule, strengthening partner ties across the DMX dealer network.

a2.challenge: Unveiling premium milk formulation to 200 VIP retailers while engaging mass consumer trials at maternity expo.
a2.solution: Organized luxury Launching Event at JW Marriott (Sep 24, 2024) and interactive brand booth at Vietbaby Fair.
a2.result: Concurrence of 200 top retailers and direct engagement with thousands of parents and toddlers.

vinhtuong.title: Vinh Tuong Contractor & Dealer Solution Event 2023

vinhtuong.solution: Constructed load-testing demonstration rigs, technical display booths, and organized professional contractor seminars.
vinhtuong.result: Strengthened brand engagement with hundreds of professional installers and building material dealers.

pepsi_tet.title: Brand Activation 'Pepsi Tet – Nourish The Spirit of Tet'
pepsi_tet.challenge: Transporting Tet gift hampers and running community operations across remote, geographically isolated mountainous hamlets.

pepsi_tet.result: Directly delivered holiday cheer and gift hampers to 12,000 needy families across Vietnam.
